reason: This passage from Exodus 12 describes God's instructions to Moses and Aaron regarding the Passover and the Israelite exodus from Egypt. The model of leadership presented is entirely through divine commandment and the orderly communication of instructions to the community. The people are shown as obedient and organized in following these instructions. No violence is mentioned anywhere in the text, nor is there any depiction of unruly people being controlled through force. The leadership exemplified here is based on authority, ritual instruction, and communal coordination—not violence.
